Copy this structure into a new quiz file, then edit the IDs, title, type, and
fields. Include the finished quiz from a chapter with:

```markdown
{{< include quizzes/your-quiz-file.qmd >}}
```

````markdown
```{.quiz-yaml}
id: unique-id
title: Optional title (defaults to Learning Check if omitted)

questions:
  - id: unique-question-id
    type: free-response # free-response, multiple-choice, true-false, or numeric
    prompt: >
      Optional; remove if the title serves as the question text.
    hint: >
      Optional.
    options:
      - text: Use
      - text: For
      - text: Multiple
        correct: true
      - text: Choice
    answer: >
      Required for true-false and numeric; optional model answer for free-response.
    tolerance: 0.01 # Numeric only.
    explanation: >
      Optional.
```
````
